name: 2SC945
full_name: NPN AF Amplifier / Low-Speed Switching Transistor
description: NEC NPN general-purpose AF amplifier and low-speed switch, one of the most common Japanese small-signal NPN parts (marked 'C945'). TO-92 pinout is E-C-B (Japanese convention): collector is the center pin. Complement to the 2SA733.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-C-B left to right. Collector is the CENTER pin. Verified from NEC and UTC datasheets (both 1=E, 2=C, 3=B).

typical_application: AF amplifier driver stage and low-speed switching; a default Japanese general-purpose NPN.
gotchas: pinout is E-C-B with COLLECTOR in the CENTER, not base
NEC rates Pd 250mW and Ic 100mA; some second-source 'C945' parts advertise up to 150mA, so confirm against the actual maker
marked 'C945' (the '2S' prefix is dropped) with the rank letter and date code
